description: This file contains unit tests for the MotionHandler class in the Android application. It tests various aspects of handling motion activity and pedometer data, including permission checks, JSON validation, and error handling. The tests use JUnit and kotlinx-coroutines for asynchronous code testing, and include a fake data source mock.

classes.name: MotionHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for MotionHandler, extends NodeHandlerRobolectricTest.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity_requiresPermission
methods.description: Tests handling motion activity when permission is not granted, expects a specific error code.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity_rejectsInvalidJson
methods.description: Tests handling motion activity with invalid JSON input, expects an invalid request error.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity_returnsActivityPayload
methods.description: Tests successful handling of motion activity with valid data, verifies payload content.

methods.name: handleMotionPedometer_mapsRangeUnsupportedError
methods.description: Tests error handling when the pedometer range is unsupported, expects appropriate error code and message.
